name: xinng Schezwan chutney
ingredients_raw: Water, garlic, Ginger, Chilli, sunflower oil, Salt, Sugar soyabean, wheat caramel colour (E150c), water, Disodium 5' Guanylate, Disodium 5', Inosinate (Flavour Enhancers, E627, E631), Paprika (Natural Colour, E160c), Spices (white pepper, schezwan pepper), Acetic Acid (Acidifying Agent, E260), Sodium Benzoate Preservative, E211, Celer. CONTAINS PERMITTED CLASS II PRESERVATIVE. CONTAINS PERMITTED NATURAL COLOURS (CARAMEL, E150c & PAPRIKA, E160c)
